subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this deliverable require native WebChat tool-output linkification alongside the Control UI fix, or should it land as a focused Control UI improvement with native parity tracked separately?
rationale: The report names both surfaces, but the current implementations and test stacks are separate; source evidence establishes the Control UI gap without establishing that a coupled cross-client change is the intended release boundary.

options.title: Land Control UI first
options.body: Implement and test all Control UI tool-output paths now, then open a focused native WebChat follow-up if parity remains desired.

options.title: Require cross-client parity
options.body: Keep the issue scoped to a single coordinated change that provides equivalent safe URL presentation in Control UI and native WebChat.

recommendation.title: Land Control UI first
recommendation.body: Implement and test all Control UI tool-output paths now, then open a focused native WebChat follow-up if parity remains desired.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent review commentary and commit history connect steipete most directly to the scope decision.
